mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.procedure_id, i.student_id, i.step_id, i.item_status, i.check_type, i.check_time, i.check_by, i.create_time, i.update_time, st.step_key, st.step_name, st.required_flag from sam_procedure_item i join sam_procedure_step st on i.step_id = st.step_id where i.procedure_id = #{procedureId} order by st.order_num asc, i.step_id asc

select i.item_id, i.procedure_id, i.student_id, i.step_id, i.item_status, i.check_type, i.check_time, i.check_by, i.create_time, i.update_time, st.step_key, st.step_name, st.required_flag from sam_procedure_item i join sam_procedure_step st on i.step_id = st.step_id where i.procedure_id = #{procedureId} and i.step_id = #{stepId} limit 1

select i.item_id, i.procedure_id, i.student_id, i.step_id, i.item_status, i.check_type, i.check_time, i.check_by, i.create_time, i.update_time, st.step_key, st.step_name, st.required_flag from sam_procedure_item i join sam_procedure_step st on i.step_id = st.step_id where i.item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: insert into sam_procedure_item (procedure_id, student_id, step_id, item_status, check_type, check_time, check_by, create_time) values (#{procedureId}, #{studentId}, #{stepId}, #{itemStatus}, #{checkType}, #{checkTime}, #{checkBy}, #{createTime})

insert into sam_procedure_item (procedure_id, student_id, step_id, item_status, check_type, create_time) select p.procedure_id, p.student_id, st.step_id, '0', '0', sysdate() from sam_graduation_procedure p join sam_procedure_step st on st.status = '0'
and p.student_id = #{studentId} and not exists ( select 1 from sam_procedure_item i where i.procedure_id = p.procedure_id and i.step_id = st.step_id )

choose.when: select student_id from sam_graduation_procedure where card_returned = '1' ${column} = '1'
select student_id from sam_certificate where is_issued = '1' group by student_id
select student_id from sam_graduation_review where review_status = '1'
select student_id from sam_degree_review where review_status = '1'

mapper.select: select procedure_id as procedureId, student_id as studentId from sam_graduation_procedure where student_id in #{sid}
select user_id from sam_student where student_id = #{studentId} limit 1
